record.question: Which country has recently declared Yoga as sports activity?
record.explanation: Answer A: Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia listed yoga under permitted/licensed sports activities in November 2017. India’s AYUSH Ministry’s 29 December 2017 parliamentary reply directly records that Saudi decision. Historical/source note: Recognition/licensing as a sports activity in Saudi Arabia in 2017, without a claim that every yoga activity was previously criminalized. Reference: https://sansad.in/getFile/loksabhaquestions/annex/13/AU2001.pdf?source=pqals. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
